text:
maria: quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR with a small UX change to the Console Observability page. The tracing snippet needs a tiny tweak + a link fix. PTAL when you have a sec.
jon: thanks — can you paste the snippet here? I'll run a quick smoke.
maria: sure, snippet in the PR but copying here: ```js
// tracing hook example for Console v2
redwood.tracing.attach({
  service: 'my-app',
  sampleRate: 0.05,
  captureRoutes: ['/api/*']
});
```
zoe: minor nit — `sampleRate` should be documented as a float between 0 and 1. The PR currently says 0-100 which is confusing.
samir: also the code uses `redwood.tracing.attach` but our SDK export is `Redwood.tracing()`. We changed it in 2025. Need to keep the snippet consistent with the SDK Quickstart.
kevin: yes — we must not ship mismatched snippets. Maria, did you test this against the latest SDK?
maria: I tested locally with the 2026 alpha build; forgot we changed the surface. I'll update. Also spotted a broken link to the cost/latency breakdown diagram — the anchor changed after the last merge.
jon: for the link, is it the internal anchor `#cost-latency-breakdown`? I think the new id is `#cost-and-latency`.
maria: exactly. PR currently points to `#cost-latency-breakdown`. I'll update to `#cost-and-latency` and add a redirect note.
zoe: can we add a one-line migration note in the header for folks upgrading dashboards? e.g., "anchor id changed in Console v2.1 — update links". Keeps users from hitting 404s.
samir: +1. Also add a tiny example showing how to pass `spanTags` through the tracing hook; ops teams ask for that a lot.
kevin: if you add span example, keep it short. Docs page should remain skimmable. Maybe collapsed panel? But that's a UI request — file a follow-up issue.
maria: will update PR with: (1) snippet switched to `Redwood.tracing()` API, (2) sampleRate explanation clarified, (3) anchor fixed, (4) short migration note, (5) added `spanTags` mini-example.
docs-bot: PR 9124 assigned to @maria for updates — status: changes requested.
jon: ping me when it's updated, I'll run the examples and check the Console rendering.
zoe: also run the link-checker script: `scripts/linkcheck.sh docs/console` — found two other anchors that drifted last week.
samir: thanks — once updated, can we include the snippet in the SDK snippets index so examples stay in sync? otherwise they'll diverge again.
maria: good call. I'll add the snippet to the snippets index and include a small test that verifies the example compiles against the latest SDK in CI.
kevin: sounds good. Thanks everyone — small PR but good catch. :raised_hands:
